primary_endpoint: Change in hepatic fat fraction and change in weight from baseline to 12 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Hepatic fat fraction changed by −1.84 with semaglutide versus −1.41 with diet; weight changed by −5.30 kg versus −1.66 kg. No statistical comparisons reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: 0/38 with semaglutide and 0/17 with diet; no deaths in either group.
